_meta.note: Reconciled against contract/api-contract.json by tests/Feature/Plugins/ModuleContractReconciliationTest.php — no (method, path) pair may appear in both files. Routes below are the Phase 4 journal-correction endpoints (plan.md 'API-Vertrag'); registered as this module implements them.

routes.name: api.journal-entries.corrections.prepare
routes.notes: Prepares a guided correction: creates a locked reversal draft and an editable replacement draft from the original. Requires Idempotency-Key.

routes.name: api.journal-corrections.show
routes.notes: Returns the correction with original/reversal/replacement and their relationship links.

routes.name: api.journal-corrections.replacement.update
routes.notes: Edits only the replacement draft. Requires Idempotency-Key.

routes.name: api.journal-corrections.post
routes.notes: Posts the reversal and replacement together, atomically. Requires Idempotency-Key.

routes.name: api.journal-corrections.destroy
routes.notes: Discards an open (draft) correction. Only allowed while status is draft.
